snippet.title: STEEB - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
__________________________________________________________________________________
👉 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467470/STEEB/

STEEB is a 2D top-down, non-linear exploration game. You are a bio-robot scout, sent out to explore and survive on unknown planets. Take samples from alien organisms to gain unique abilities. Gather scraps and strategically choose upgrades. Will your discoveries save humanity?

Credits:
Game design, programming, art, music by Frosi (Woven Shrine Games)
Sounds from various cc0 sources
